## What Is Mobbin Used For?

Mobbin is a curated reference library of real mobile and web app screenshots. Designers, UX researchers and PMs use it to study how shipped products handle onboarding, checkout, settings, paywalls and the other flows everyone has to build eventually.

It's good at that. The library is large, updated often, and the flow view genuinely helps when you're sequencing screens rather than polishing one.

results.title: Learning UI (Week 5)…I tried Mobbin & Pageflows…
results.content:
My first encounter with Mobbin was sometime last year, while searching for app screens for Starbucks. Since i’m based in Nigeria, there are certain apps I can’t download from the App store, unless I use a VPN…

I heard about Pageflows in a design community from the UX/UI Bootcamp I just completed in May, and I realized it was very similar to Mobbin.

So I went ahead and paid for a quarterly subscription of both, and I am so obsessed with them. [...] I’m currently working on an app with a few people from my bootcamp, while working on finishing up my portfolio, and I’ve seen how much I’m asking better questions, creating better flows, while keeping the user and business in mind.

My UI & Visual design are still a work in progress, and Mobbin and Pageflow will help me with that.
